correctness.rationale: Root-bipartition recursion yields (2n−3)!! distinct rooted binary tree cluster systems; the 60 queries ab|c are true exactly when some proper cluster contains a,b but not c. Independent reconstruction generated all 945 trees and query incidence masks. Fixing the first query by S6 relabeling, an exhaustive canonical shattered-support recursion found counts of sizes 1..5 equal 1,57,1458,18144,0, giving VC=4. The actual frozen depth9_certificate.json was independently traversed against reconstructed tree masks: 511 internal nodes, 512 distinct consistent leaf concepts, so Ldim≥9; 945<1024 excludes 10. Attached original checker also handles n=3,4,5. Zero response allows either other triplet topology, not a specified multiclass alternative; this convention is essential.
